Just verify nothing higher than id2 is deleted.\n        foreach r $res_after {\n            set rid [lindex $r 0]\n            # rid should be >= id2\n        }\n    }\n\n    test {XTRIM with MINID deletes all when threshold is higher than all} {\n        r DEL mystream\n        r XADD mystream 10-1 key value\n        set id1 [r XADD mystream * key value]\n        set id2 [r XADD mystream * key value]\n        # Use a threshold higher than all\n        set deleted [r XTRIM mystream MINID 9999999999999-0]\n        assert_equal $deleted 3\n        assert_equal [r XLEN mystream] 0\n    }\n\n    test {XTRIM with MINID deletes none when threshold is lower than all} {\n        r DEL mystream\n        r XADD mystream 10-1 key value\n        set id1 [r XADD mystream * key value]\n        set id2 [r XADD mystream * key value]\n        set deleted [r XTRIM mystream MINID 5-0]\n        assert_equal $deleted 0\n        assert_equal [r XLEN mystream] 3\n    }\n}\nEOF\necho \"Created comprehensive repro test\""}", "name": "bash"}, "id": "call_-7355708531846150540", "index": 0, "type": "function"}]}}], "created": 1700000044, "id": "synthesized-00044", "model": "glm-5.2", "object": "chat.completion", "request_id": "synthesized-00044", "usage": {"completion_tokens": 0, "prompt_tokens": 0, "total_tokens": 0}}
